intent_contract.text: 프롬프트 작성하고 이미지 생성하도록 하여 잘 반영되었는지 테스트해줘

Create an independent reference-guided photographic stress test in which the selected random complex concept makes Andean poncho topology, panel drape, neck opening, and woven structure visibly judgeable.

Create a full-length photorealistic field-fashion documentary: a pre-dawn high-altitude astronomy scene built around an Andean poncho silhouette above a cloud inversion. The subject is the same adult woman shown in the supplied portrait reference. Her facial structure, eye aperture and spacing, nose, lips, jawline, adult age, and long dark hair remain faithfully matched to that reference. She wears a handwoven rectangular poncho with a central neck slit, broad front and back panels dropping from both shoulders, disciplined warp-colored bands, and hand-finished lower edges over practical field layers. She braces a wind-loosened field notebook against a telescope case as the poncho spreads in the crosswind, making its uninterrupted shoulder-to-panel geometry visible. Show the neck opening, front panel, rear edge, stripe continuity, thickness, and free side drape together. Use a low full-body viewpoint, cold dawn rim light, realistic woven fibers, airborne dust, and precise observatory hardware.
